notes.title: Sunday Stream!
notes.content:
Finish your weekend with some electronic music - Join our stream!

On Sunday, we will be streaming Hexagroove and we'd love it if you joined and played along with us! 

When?
Sunday - February 21st at 8:00 PM PT / 11:00 PM ET / 05:00 AM CET (Feb 22nd) / 13:00 JST (Feb 22nd)

What we will show in the stream:

 Customization - In Hexagroove you unlock the ability to customize your own packs of loops and control how the loops are being played to the crowd, just like a true DJ! 
 Amazing music - A great music game requires high fidelity sound. In Hexagroove you will experience top quality audio from fifteen genres made by internationally-acclaimed artists!
 Ask me anything - Curious about the origins of Hexagroove and its Japanese roots?  Lead programmer of Elite Beat Agents and Gitaroo Man Lives! David Ventura will be on hand to answer and tell all about this title's journey from Tokyo, to Stockholm, to your living room.

notes.title: 🎉European Festival Expansion🎶
notes.content:
New music and levels

[previewyoutube=JCXkn9ETJt0;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]Hexagroove initially launched with 10 genres and 420 loops spanning classic genres such as House, Techno, and Drum & Bass.  Over the past year we've added more artists from Scotland and Japan with content updates. 

Now are proud to bring the music back home to Sweden with our European Festival expansion: thumping Deep House and frenetic Liquid Drum 'n Bass, topping 720 loops to build custom kits with.

A new place to play

The European Festival Expansion also reaches for the stars and brings an entire new club to spin in, Rymd, on the suface of the moon itself! Aliens abduct party goers and lunar landers abound in our craziest club yet.  Play the native Liquid DnB by Big Skapinsky here, or any of the other 14 genres in our creative Freestyle mode.

[previewyoutube=ek_kJ75IOAM;full][/previewyoutube]

Ask questions, follow us online!
We love to hear from you!  Start a discussion in the Steam Community Hub and follow us on Twitter, Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram for pro tips on achievement-hunting and music-making.

Happy DJing,
/David

notes.title: Achievement Guide Part 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797105/cebefee61e2959a3cbfcd95672810d5ed0861bbc.gif

Time for our second achievement guide, because who doesn't love achievements?!

Achievement Guide Part 2

Back in Style

Generate more than 1985 style points on a level

Easy way to get a lot of style points is to do “Quick Fingers” over and over again, starting two loops one pulse and stopping them the pulse after. Rinse Repeat.

Up in Smoke

Trigger the Smokin' trick

You need to use at least two controllers. Select a multiplayer mode and then use “R1” as a Superfan just as the music bar changes.

By the Book

100% completion percentage

Complete all the other achievements to earn this.

Hard and Soft

Clear every stage with bang and fade at any difficulty

You need to do this on the same difficulty level for it to actually trigger 

The Road Warrior

Play a Freestyle song in every club

Literally what it says, play a Freestyle song in every club

In the Loop

Trigger more than 2525 loops

This has to be done in campaign, a tip is to do this together with the “Number One” achievement. Turn of or on two loops every bar. I recommend doing this on either normal or easy as your health drops slower.

Epic Sax Guy

Trigger the Synthwave sax solo 30 times

Play Synthwave and as often as possible turn on and off the six o’clock → three o’clock loop. 

Who Needs Melody

Clear a campaign level using only drum, percussion, and bass

You need to find a level that always have either drum, percussion and bass available. Then simply stick to using those instruments and nothing else. A level starts with another instrument loop going is not a viable level to do this.

The Comeback Kid

Clear a stage on hard after getting a SLOW DOWN message

SLOW DOWN is triggered once try to active 3 or more loops during the same bar.

Trigger Happy

Launch five or more loops in a single measure and lose

This is tough to do on levels with a higher BPM, try doing it on a slower level. To make sure you you lose, play on hard difficulty.

See you next Monday for part 3!

notes.title: Achievement Guide Part 1 (And whispers of new content?!)
notes.content:
We meet again Hexagroovers, I introduce you to the first part of a three part achievement guide, explaining a bit more in detail what you need to do for certain achievements. I've also added a small (big?) hint to upcoming new content somewhere in the post, see if you can find it!

Achievement Guide Part 1

Number 1

"Achieve the DJ title of Hexamaster Supreme and cleared every stage on every difficulty"

So this is achievement is really split into two separate requirements. Achieving Hexamaster Supreme means gaining enough Style Points (60k), this is achieved by doing as many tricks as possible without actually failing a level. Easy way to get a lot of style points is to do “Quick Fingers” over and over again, starting two loops one pulse and stopping them the pulse after. Rinse Repeat.

The second part is literally what it says, clear every level on every difficulty, you don’t need a specific score, you just need to pass the level.

Balls in the Air

"Juggle the rhythm ball for 75 times or more in a level"

Many people get this simply by playing campaign. If you are struggling to get this, try to chose Loops that build Euphoria slower, loops with either the snowflake or whirlwind works well for that. Note: To make the ball appear you need to have all loops activated and blue.

Fingers of Fury

"Get a 10 score on rhythm in every hard stage"

Practice makes perfect. To actually practice this part you can go to Freestyle mode and do it over and over again until you feel ready for the campaign stage.

Control Freak

"Get a 10 on control in every hard stage"

Practice makes perfect. To actually practice this part you can go to Freestyle mode and do it over and over again until you feel ready for the campaign stage.

Don't Stop the Party

"Clear a campaign level in more than 7 minutes"

You can get less euphoria by not having all the instruments active at all times, also the upper half of the instruments generate less euphoria. The less euphoria you get the slower you will progress.

Extended Set

"Play a Freestyle session for more than 10 minutes with crowd and sound effects off"

You can turn them off in the options menu, once you’ve done that just start playing freestyle on your favorite venue!

Pure Perfection

"Get perfect 10s in all categories in all hard stages"

The toughest achievement in the game. There is no real trick to this, but you should follow the rules of music and also not pay attention to DJ tricks. Style points does not matter for this achievement.

Crate Digging

"Use a custom loop pack with an alternate instrument on a Campaign stage"

Create an alternate loop pack once you have cleared a venue on campaign mode. Then use that alternate loop pack while playing.

Paft Dunk

"Play Cooperative or Freestyle with 2 DJs"

Requires two separate controllers. Simply have two players pick DJ and then start a stage.

Band-Aids

"Play Cooperative or Freestyle with 2 Superfans"

Requires 3 separate controllers. 1 DJ and 2 Superfans. Select 3 players and then start a stage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797105/cebefee61e2959a3cbfcd95672810d5ed0861bbc.gif

See you next week for Part 2, happy DJing!

notes.title: 🎧 Artist Statement 👨‍🎨 and Musical Demo Launch 🚀
notes.content:
What is Hexagroove: Tactical DJ?
[previewyoutube=drfLy4WU_7k;full][/previewyoutube]
Hexagroove is a game unlike any other.  It blends the best parts of action, rhythm, and strategy titles to provide a truly creative DJ experience.  In the game you have complete control over which musical loops you'll combine to best impress the crowd.  Six rules of music making and a bag full of unlockable DJ tricks guide you on your journey to performance mastery.

Who made the game?
[previewyoutube=JCXkn9ETJt0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]Ichigoichie is a two-person Swedish/Japanese studio with deep music-making roots. I started my career at iNiS in Tokyo and was the lead programmer on a number of music classics including Ouendan, Elite Beat Agents, Gitaroo-Man Lives!, and the karaoke smash Lips for Xbox 360.  

In Hexagroove, I assembled a cadre of performing artists from around the world to put together the musical blocks you'll combine in our realtime strategy title.  Genres and producers in the full version include: Legowelt (Electro), Runners Club 95 (Synthwave), Mr. YT / Yuji Takenouchi (Techno, Minimal), CYLON (Psytrance), No. 9 Orchestra (Chill Out), Big Skapinsky (Liquid DnB), TWIDDL (Deep House), SEXY-SYNTHESIZER (Chiprock), DÉ DÉ MOUSE (Nu Garage), lallow (IDM), and Kristoffer Wallman (House, Trance, Drum and Bass, Electro House).

Why did we make it?
[previewyoutube=Tq-5CWyh9co;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]Before designing Hexagroove I thought back to how difficult it was for me to get started as a musician. Using audio software had so many instruments, presets, buttons... and you never got any feedback on how you were doing in making the music.  

I love going to raves...I love listening to club music...it's a such big part of my life that affected me growing up.  What I wanted to do in this title was build something on that wide expanse between addictive games like Guitar Hero and the endless, blank canvas of professional audio software.  And I wanted to do it in a way that recreated the excitement of being at a party-- feeling the energy in the air as the DJ combined the music such artful ways.  I think Hexagroove brings all this together because while all the music in the game is controlled entirely by you, it will never sound bad and you don't have to feel the frustration of things lining up off the beat or being out of musical key.

What more does the full version contain?
Beyond the two-level free demo, the full version contains everything you'll need to start on the road of dance music mastery including an additional:
* 5 club venues of increasing scale
* 11 genres (with an additional free expansion planned for December)
* 4 more instruments
* 9 skateboarding-style DJ tricks for high score mastery
* 2-4 player local co-op Entourage mode for two skill levels of players
* 1-4 player Freestyle mode where you can play around making music endlessly or practice rhythm charts and beats
* stats, records, and 30 achievements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797105/0d782c7ed91be050d9cf02330611c9fbd7a552c7.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797105/4ba21e80b5b1e68a6755e401d4d7b9d57e3a0bff.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797105/f49b2f88e64790387727b65fc2e07b65b0269376.png

Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram for pro-achievement tips, trivia, and giveaways, and check out our YouTube for how-to and artist highlight videos.

I look forward to seeing what kind of Freestyle sets you can cook up!
- David Ventura, CEO
